source_use: Functional format facts only; independently authored implementation/fixtures. Downloaded upstream source stays local and is never compiled or executed.
reconciliation: Microsoft specifies an NTFS3.0/3.1 list with quadword-aligned entries; it labels the name-offset and final16-bit field reserved. The pinned Linux layout uses the former to locate name bytes and the latter as an attribute identifier. Preserve both raw values; do not require zero.

Both pinned readers iterate inside the supplied list-value length. NTFS-3G explicitly checks length alignment and treats a partial next header as corruption. A FILE-record FFFFFFFF marker is not a list-value terminator.

This parser consumes a bounded supplied span only. Sorting, volume name collation, uniqueness, live file-reference/sequence validity and complete logical streams require later source-bound interpretation.
